title: Clean Air, Water Bodies and Single-Use Plastic Prohibition Bill
jurisdiction: India — proposed Union legislation with State, Union Territory and local-government implementation
source_or_instruction: User request: ban one-time-use plastic and pollution/disposal of sewage, biological, religious, chemical and industrial waste in water bodies; impose accountable public duties; recognise clean air and water as essential to all living beings; add financial assurance, waste-chain and export controls, independent monitoring, community remedies, climate-pollutant controls, anti-greenwashing and public-interest enforcement safeguards.
notes: Complete this index record; do not treat it as legal evidence. Proposed Central consequential amendments and technical schedules are in 01-draft/not-ready-for-introduction.md; the completion record is 03-validation/technical-schedules-and-central-amendments-completion-report.md; State/UT substantive law remains unverified.
